name: gitx-guided-pr
title: GitX Guided Git and Pull Request Flow
description: A guided, visible Git workflow inspired by GitX: inspect repository state and history, isolate work, make small commits, verify, request review, and prepare a pull request without implicit remote mutation.

verifyCommands.description: Check whitespace errors and capture the final diff summary.
Run the project's declared focused verification commands.

planner.description: Makes repository state, branch base, scope, and stop conditions explicit before edits.

executor.description: Makes small, reviewable local changes and commits only within the approved scope.

reviewer.description: Reviews the diff, commit history, verification evidence, and PR readiness.

observer.description: Maintains the state transition and records the final handoff without performing remote mutation.

steps.task: Inspect git status, current branch, upstream, recent history, and changed-file ownership. Summarize base commit, working-tree state, scope, and non-goals. Stop if unrelated user changes or an unclear base branch make safe isolation impossible.

Use an AMH isolated worktree when dispatch isolation is enabled; otherwise preserve the current tree and do not overwrite unrelated edits. Record branch, worktree, base commit, and ownership before implementation.

Implement the approved scope in small coherent increments. Keep commits reviewable and explain what each commit changes. Do not push, merge, reset, delete, or install dependencies without fresh approval.
Run focused project verification, git diff --check, and capture changed files, diff stat, commit list, test results, and residual risks. Mark review-ready only when evidence is present.

Review the branch/worktree, commit history, diff, tests, and safety constraints. Return PASS only when the change is reviewable and PR-ready; otherwise list blockers with file or command evidence. A PR-ready result does not authorize push or merge.

If review or verification fails, create a bounded repair attempt and repeat verification. If both pass, record a PR handoff containing branch, base, commits, diff summary, tests, review result, and explicit next action: human-authorized push/PR/merge. Never perform remote mutation implicitly.
